summary.text: Larry Alley is a Republican member of the Kansas Senate representing District 32 (Cowley County), and the Legislature's member page lists service in the Senate since 2017.
Larry Alley is listed as chair of the Commerce Committee.

paragraphs.text: Larry Alley is listed as a member of the Commerce Committee, the Agriculture and Natural Resources Committee, the Government Efficiency Committee and the Ways and Means Committee.
The Legislature lists Larry Alley's occupation as Retired.
The page names Sondra Alley as Larry Alley's spouse.
